title: Tomorrow's school bag
offscreen: The list stays up by the door and is used every evening with the real school bag, without the tablet.

materials.label: A sheet of paper and some felt-tip pens
Masking tape to hang up the list

steps.text: Look at the timetable with a grown-up: what's on tomorrow?
Draw on the list the things you need tomorrow, one per line.
Take one thing at a time, put it in the bag and touch its drawing.
Hang the list by the door: tomorrow evening you'll find it there.

levels.control: The list: if a drawing doesn't have its thing in the bag yet, you can see it.
levels.observe: Whether the next evening they take the list on their own, and whether they add something that was missing.

intro.bo: {nome}, shall we get tomorrow ready tonight? You need the real school bag and a grown-up nearby.
intro.pilu: {nome}, a list you draw yourself helps you remember. The grown-up will show you how.
intro.tango: {nome}! The school bag! I'd fit in it whole... You only put in what you need.

outro.bo: The bag is ready, {nome}. Tomorrow morning you don't have to think about it.
outro.pilu: The list stays up, {nome}: tomorrow evening it's already there.
outro.tango: Done! {nome}, the list remembers for me too.
